title: Opus 5.5 short tasks: direct vs OSS v1 vs OSS v2, beside the published gateway rows

arms.plain: Claude Code alone (direct). Empty strict MCP map, no plugin.
arms.v1: OSS plugin v1: origin/main a92cf6a77ac02971fb5fafe2155e5ee229491884, version 1.0.169, built with npm install --omit=dev.
arms.v2: OSS plugin v2: v2-design 8f38bdbca6d2be974d90492e683b1b3073f1b63c built to release-out (manifest version 0.0.0-dev).
arms.gateway: Claude Code talks to Anthropic through the Context Mode gateway. Published rows (2026-09-29) and the bridge pairs only.

cost_basis: List price on the token counts in each session's result event, per model. Cache writes whose lifetime is not split are priced at the 1 hour rate (usd) and the 5 minute rate (usd_low). Claude Code's own total_cost_usd is kept as usd_client; a gap above 1% sets client_gap_flag. Bridge gateway sessions: the gateway's per-call record, hidden calls included. The runs used a claude.ai login: there is no per-token invoice, so every figure is a list-price equivalent.
analysis_method: Every measured cycle, failures included, no outlier dropped. Per workload, d = arm - plain per cycle. % = 100 x mean(d) / mean(plain), with the 95% t interval. Verdict: less when the whole interval is below zero, more when above, else same. arm_wins: cycles where the arm cost less than plain. v2 against v1 is secondary. Gateway rows are the published rows, cited by workload id, each against its own published plain arm.

pooled.note: A sum over pairs, not a mean of rows. No interval: the rows are different tasks.

legend.col.cwx: cache write tokens whose lifetime was not saved: usd_recomputed prices them at the 1 hour rate (Claude Code's main thread), usd_recomputed_low at the 5 minute rate
legend.col.in: input tokens not read from or written to the cache
legend.col.missing: a token column left out of a block is all zeros; model indexes into models
legend.col.out: output tokens; null = not saved per call
legend.from.client_first_call: Claude Code's stream: the first call's input-side usage only
legend.from.ledger_first_row: the gateway ledger: the first row of the session only
legend.rest.after_first_call: the gateway ledger's session totals minus the first row
legend.why.first_call_only: Only the first call's input-side tokens were saved for this arm. The run folders with the other calls were deleted after the run.
